message:
Running command: SCRIPT=""
if [ -f /workspace/collect_diagnostics.sh ]; then
  SCRIPT="/workspace/collect_diagnostics.sh"
else
  echo "collect_diagnostics.sh not found at /workspace. Searching..."
  SCRIPT="$(find /workspace -maxdepth 4 -type f -name 'collect_diagnostics.sh' 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
  if [ -z "$SCRIPT" ]; then
    SCRIPT="$(find / -maxdepth 4 -type f -name 'collect_diagnostics.sh' 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
  fi
fi

if [ -z "$SCRIPT" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: collect_diagnostics.sh not found on the system."
  exit 1
fi

echo "Found script at: $SCRIPT"
echo "Running diagnostics script..."
set -o pipefail
bash "$SCRIPT" | tee /workspace/diagnostics_output.log
STATUS=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
echo "Diagnostics script exit code: $STATUS"
echo "----- Diagnostics output (saved to /workspace/diagnostics_output.log) -----"
tail -n +1 /workspace/diagnostics_output.log || true
exit $STATUS
